card.name: Space before a number in dosing text
card.fires_on: The blank space right before a numeral, usually a dose, count or interval, after words like 'of', 'above', 'approximately' or 'with'. Mostly in dosing sentences and tables.

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: A space just before a daily dose amount after 'of' or 'above'.
modes.example: clinical experience with daily doses above<< >>1,600 mg of ent

modes.label: Space before interval number
modes.description: A space before an hours or frequency number in dosing schedules.
modes.example: in 2 doses approximately<< >>12 hours apart) on Days

modes.label: Space before a count
modes.description: A space before a large count in general web text.
modes.example: Facebook has over 500 million active users with<< >>250 million users accessing their accounts

card.writes: It pushes the model away from 'regular' and 'regularly' words, which fits a number being expected next.
card.plain: It fires on the gap just before a number in dosing text, where an amount or interval comes next.
